segments.normalizedSource: ```objc - (void)awakeFromNib { NSSharingService * service = [NSSharingService sharingServiceNamed:NSSharingServiceNamePostOnTwitter]; [myShareOnTwitterButton setTitle:service.title]; [myShareOnTwitterButton setEnabled:[service canPerformWithItems:nil]]; } - (IBAction)shareOnTwitter:(id)sender { // Items to share NSAttributedString *text = [self.textView attributedString]; NSImage *image = [self.imageView image]; NSArray * shareItems = [NSArray arrayWithObjects:text, image, nil]; NSSharingService *service = [NSSharingService sharingServiceNamed:NSSharingServiceNamePostOnTwitter]; service.delegate = self; [service performWithItems:shareItems]; } ```
